name: Hesperian-Shoal
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past towering mountain ranges, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
